user_query: I'm eagerly waiting for the completion of my movie session. Can you check the status of the movie session using the 'Check Movie Status' API? If the movie is ready, I would like to download it using the 'Get Movie' API. Furthermore, I would like to gather information about the movie from the 'Get Video info' API.

TaskList.description: Check the current status of the movie session to determine if the movie is ready for download.
If the movie is ready, download the movie using the 'Get Movie' API.
Retrieve detailed information about the movie from the 'Get Video info' API.
